# defeated by

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:defeatedBy`](gmeow-defeatedBy.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/defeatedBy>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/epistemics`](../../slices/epistemics.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A doxastic state or standpoint-claim is marked with a justification-defeat status — a solver-set flag such as Gettier-case or defeated. Non-functional: a state or claim may carry several defeat markers over time, and old markers are suppressed rather than erased ([Principle 10](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-10)). This is a solver annotation only; the reasoner never promotes or retracts it ([Principle 12](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-12)).

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:JustificationSubject`](../classes/gmeow-JustificationSubject.md) -> [`gmeow:JustificationStatus`](../classes/gmeow-JustificationStatus.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:defeatedBy`](gmeow-defeatedBy.md) from [`gmeow:JustificationSubject`](../classes/gmeow-JustificationSubject.md) to [`gmeow:JustificationStatus`](../classes/gmeow-JustificationStatus.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

```turtle
@prefix gmeow: <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/> .

@prefix xsd:   <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#> .



# --- Case 2: Gettier-defeated belief (stopped clock) -------------------------
# Same evidential kind as Case 1, but the basis is misleading: the clock is
# stopped and only happens to show the correct time. The solver marks the state
# as a Gettier case; the reasoner never infers this.
ex:adaGettierBelief a gmeow:DoxasticState ;
    rdfs:label "Ada's Gettier-defeated belief that it is noon"@en ;
    gmeow:epistemicAgent ex:ada ;
    gmeow:doxasticContent ex:timeNoon ;
    gmeow:credence "0.95"^^xsd:decimal ;
    gmeow:doxasticClaim ex:adaGettierClaim ;
    gmeow:justifiedBy ex:stoppedClockReading ;
    gmeow:defeatedBy gmeow:justificationStatusGettier .
```

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to flag that a reified [`gmeow:DoxasticState`](../classes/gmeow-DoxasticState.md) or [`gmeow:StandpointClaim`](../classes/gmeow-StandpointClaim.md) has a known justification problem (Gettier case, defeated, undercut, rebutted) as determined by the solver layer.

### Avoid when

- Avoid treating it as a reasoner-entailed truth bit or as a deletion signal; it is a solver annotation and should be paired with [`gmeow:displayable`](gmeow-displayable.md) false for suppressed defeated claims rather than erasing them.

### How to use

- Point from a [`gmeow:DoxasticState`](../classes/gmeow-DoxasticState.md) or [`gmeow:StandpointClaim`](../classes/gmeow-StandpointClaim.md) at one or more [`gmeow:JustificationStatus`](../classes/gmeow-JustificationStatus.md) individuals; update by minting a new status link and suppressing the old one with [`gmeow:displayable`](gmeow-displayable.md) false ([Principle 10](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-10)).

### Examples

- ex:aliceBelievesRound [`gmeow:defeatedBy`](gmeow-defeatedBy.md) [`gmeow:justificationStatusGettier`](../individuals/gmeow-justificationStatusGettier.md).
